title: PRO-Bid: Pareto-Prioritized Regret Optimization for Constraint-Aware Generative Auto-Bidding
abstract: arXiv:2602.08261v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Auto-bidding systems strive to maximize marketing value while maintaining high compliance with efficiency constraints, such as Target Cost-Per-Action (CPA). While Decision Transformers offer powerful sequence modeling capabilities, their application to this setting faces two challenges: 1) standard Return-to-Go conditioning causes state aliasing by ignoring the cost dimension, preventing precise resource pacing; and 2) standard regression constrains the policy to mimic historical averages, limiting its capacity to optimize performance near the high-efficiency boundary. translated_title: PRO-Bid：面向约束感知的生成式自动出价的帕累托优先遗憾优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.08261v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：自动出价系统旨在最大化营销价值，同时保持对效率约束（如目标每行动成本（CPA））的高度合规。尽管决策变换器提供了强大的序列建模能力，但其在此场景中的应用面临两个挑战：1）标准的返回到目标（Return-to-Go）条件化通过忽略成本维度导致状态混叠，阻碍了精确的资源节奏控制；2）标准回归将策略限制为模仿历史平均值，限制了其在高效率边界附近优化性能的能力。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了PRO-Bid，一个约束感知的生成式自动出价框架，通过两种协同机制在数据、架构和训练方面进行系统性重新设计：1）约束解耦帕累托表示（CDPR）将全局约束分离为递归成本和价值上下文，以恢复资源感知，同时重新加权...
tldr: 本文提出PRO-Bid框架，通过约束解耦帕累托表示和协同训练机制，解决了自动出价中状态混叠和策略限制问题，实现了约束下的高效优化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the PRO-Bid framework, which addresses state aliasing and policy limitations in auto-bidding through constraint-decoupled Pareto representation and synergistic training mechanisms, enabling efficient optimization under constraints.
